_comment: The v2 scenery factory (maintainer's structure, 2026-08-12): 100 ranked TYPES, each a group folder scenery/<id>/. Quota per type = max(floor, base + step*rank) -> #1 trees 100, #2 stones 98 ... floor 2 so EVERY type ships its LIGHTS_ON + LIGHTS_OFF pair. Pieces are SOUTH-only 1-direction PixelLab objects, tagged SCENERY, generated ONE per call (create-8-direction-object <=168px, keeping only SOUTH; single create-1-direction-object above), half lit / half unlit, deterministic plan in pipeline/catalog.py. [2026-08-13] style_base now carries the two laws the maintainer's 438 wiki verdicts wrote: NO baked-in text, and NO hair-thin parts (solid grounded mass reads; poles/ropes/spokes/lattice do not). [2026-08-13] Groups 101-110 added on the maintainer's direction: mountain-wall decor (cliff_vines, cliff_features — layered over the wall tiles to break their repetition), indoor/house detail so a house feels lived in (tables, chairs_and_benches, beds, cupboards_and_shelves, hearths, rugs_and_hides, house_clutter), and wall_hangings for the coming top-wall-visible mechanic. These carry an explicit 'quota' field overriding the rank formula (rank>=51 would floor them at 2). Trees/stones variety was deepened so maps2 can theme REGIONS with coherent subsets — different areas get different trees. [2026-08-13 round-4] PLACEMENT LAW: no piece may imply infrastructure the world lacks — working machinery needs its network (rails, rivers), so connected things are designed ABANDONED/derelict instead; and whole buildings are never props (they read as miniatures beside the player — the maps2 agent builds buildings).
style_base: cozy painterly RPG pixel art in the exact style of Grave Seasons, a cohesive muted-but-warm seasonal palette, soft naturalistic lighting with strong ambient occlusion and gently rounded volumes, subtle selective darker-tone outlines (NOT a hard uniform black cartoon outline), bold readable shapes built from clean deliberate pixel clusters, every detail drawn at least a few pixels wide, no fine-grained noisy texture, no sub-pixel detail, sturdy chunky forms with generous thickness and NO hair-thin parts, the object sitting solidly on the ground with visible weight, absolutely no written text, no letters, no numbers, no words and no readable signage anywhere on it, no people, no human figures and no characters anywhere in the image, a single centered inanimate game prop on a transparent background

quota_rule._comment: quota(rank) = max(floor, base + step*rank). The floor keeps the maintainer's 'two versions of every type' promise: every type gets at least its ON/OFF pair. One knob to grow the bottom half later.

lights.off_clause: completely unlit, no glow, no light sources, no self-emission
lights.on_clause: self-emissive at night, softly radiating light
lights._comment: Composed into every piece prompt: odd piece numbers are LIGHTS_OFF, even are LIGHTS_ON with a per-piece glow concept from the group's glow_concepts.

scale._comment: REALISM RULE: scenery is scaled to the world by real height. 64px == 1.7m character; world_px_height = round(world_height_m * 64 / 1.7).

budget._comment: A batch may run while the subscription pool sits above the fleet's shared floor (coordination/PROTOCOL.md) OR usd credits sit above min_usd. The loop stops cleanly at the floor and simply resumes next day.

groups.name: Tree

broad chestnut with a deep round canopy
dark ancient yew, dense and brooding
black alder with cones, waterside tree
stout dead oak, thick bare limbs
glow_concepts: iron lantern hung from a low branch
golden sap veins glowing through bark cracks
swarm of fireflies drifting through the crown
blue-white soul-light spilling from a knot hole
teal bioluminescent moss patches up the trunk
carved initials glowing ember-orange in the bark
memorial candles nestled between the roots
pale blossoms shining faintly across the branches
groups.animation_idea: crown foliage swaying gently in the wind with a few leaves drifting loose
groups.lore_fit: Every remembered climbing-tree and churchyard oak still stands here, so Nangijala's valleys are stitched together out of the trees the dead could not forget.

groups.name: Stone

variety: glacial erratic perched on smaller stones
glow_concepts: thin runes etched glowing warm amber
patches of luminous blue-green moss
molten orange soulstone veins in deep cracks
glowing pale handprint pressed on the face
tiny golden memory motes drifting above it
ring of ghost-blue lichen circles
ember light leaking from a hollow beneath
groups.animation_idea: moss glow softly pulsing while golden motes drift up
groups.lore_fit: Every plain stone is a fact somebody still remembers about a field or a path, the humblest furniture of the remembered valleys.

groups.name: Grave
groups.description: a weathered granite headstone with a carved name, standing on a low grassy mound with small wildflowers at its base
glow_concepts: carved name letters glowing warm amber
single votive candle flickering at the base
pale soul-wisp hovering above the stone
bioluminescent moss veining the cracks
thin soulstone vein glinting through the rock
small lantern hung on the marker
luminous white flowers blooming against the stone
groups.animation_idea: votive candle flame flickering while a pale soul-wisp bobs slowly
groups.lore_fit: A grave with a legible name is a spoken fact holding its shape — the first defense against the Quiet.

groups.name: Brazier
groups.description: a wide metal fire bowl standing on three splayed legs, heaped with coals and split logs
glow_concepts: roaring orange wood flame above the bowl
deep red coal bed breathing light
silver-white soul-fire burning without smoke
green copper-salt flame licking the rim
molten soulstone shards glowing among coals
column of drifting gold sparks
coals glowing through the weave in stripes
groups.animation_idea: flames licking upward with sparks drifting off
groups.lore_fit: A tended brazier is sacred infrastructure — the broken re-form beside its heat, and talk around it firms the ground like frost leaving the earth.

groups.name: Lantern Post
groups.description: a shoulder-height wooden post with a small metal-framed glass lantern fixed on its flat top
glow_concepts: steady candle flame behind horn panes
green foxfire packed behind the panes
smokeless white soul-flame floating on the wick
glass jar packed with gathered fireflies
raw glowing amber soulstone chunk
thread of woven light burning like a wick
groups.animation_idea: candle flame wavering with faint light spill
groups.lore_fit: Lantern courtesy is how neighbors tell each other a path is still remembered, so a lit post means the way beyond it has not gone soft.

groups.name: Waystone
groups.description: a rough upright standing stone planted in the ground, weathered granite, worn carved spirals and rune-like symbols, moss at its base
glow_concepts: carved runes glowing warm amber
soulstone veins threading the rock alight
cap of luminous blue moss
ring of foxfire mushrooms at the base
warm handprint glow where travelers touch
inner light leaking through hairline cracks
engraved pointing hand lit like a signpost
glowworms clustered in the carved lettering
groups.animation_idea: rune glow pulsing slowly brighter and dimmer
groups.lore_fit: Waystones are facts pressed toward mineral — direction and distance worn down to one carved certainty that even the Quiet chews slowly.

groups.name: Torch Post
groups.description: a rough wooden stake with an oil-soaked cloth-wrapped torch head bound at its top
glow_concepts: ragged orange flame trailing black smoke
smokeless pale-blue soul-flame
slow blue resin flame with white core
ember-crusted head glowing without open flame
halo of glow-moths circling the head
molten pitch dripping in glowing beads
groups.animation_idea: flame streaming sideways as if in wind
groups.lore_fit: Torch posts line the roads between fires, planted by walkers who wanted the dark stretches between remembered places to stay short.

groups.name: Signpost
groups.description: a stout wooden fingerpost with thick heavy blank arrow boards of bare weathered wood, set in a solid base
glow_concepts: painted place-names glowing like embers
gilded lettering lit from within
arrow edges limned with firefly light
small oil lamp bracketed beneath the arms
rune-burned names shining through the wood
soft halo around one true arrow
groups.animation_idea: loosest arm creaking and rocking slightly
groups.lore_fit: Written place-names are load-bearing in Nangijala — a signpost literally keeps its destinations from going soft, and a faded arm means somewhere is being forgotten.

groups.name: Cairn
groups.description: a broad sturdy pile of large stacked rocks built as a trail marker, wide at the base, made of heavy weathered stones
glow_concepts: topmost stone glowing like a lantern
warm light spilling from gaps between stones
chalk name-marks shining white on each stone
wisps of soul-light circling the peak
cold blue soul-light seeping from under the base
groups.animation_idea: warm light flickering in the gaps between the stones
groups.lore_fit: Travelers stack them so a path stays spoken of, each added stone a small promise that the way will not go soft.

groups.name: Fence
groups.description: a short freestanding run of rough wooden fence, two or three posts with split rails between them
glow_concepts: small tin lantern hung on the end post
foxfire fungus shelves on a rotting rail
carved farm-mark rune shining on a post
golden glow where hands wore the top rail smooth
glowworms dotted along the lower rail
pale soulstone cap stones on the posts
groups.animation_idea: a loose rail rocking gently in the wind
groups.lore_fit: Fences are the boundary lines neighbors argued over and therefore remember hardest, standing firm in fields long after the fields themselves have gone soft.

groups.name: Well
groups.description: a round fieldstone well with thick stone walls and a heavy peaked wooden roof on two stout posts, a chunky windlass
glow_concepts: soft blue soul-light rising from the water below
hanging tin lantern lit under the roof peak
glowing runes carved around the stone rim
raised bucket brimming with luminous water
pale green moonmoss between the stones
soulstone vein glinting through cracked stonework
groups.animation_idea: the windlass rope swaying and light glinting on the water below
groups.lore_fit: Every remembered village drew water somewhere, so the well is the certainty a whole street agreed on, deep enough that soul-light pools where the memory does.

groups.name: Hedge
groups.description: a dense solid block of clipped hedge with a flat top and thick leafy sides, foliage reaching all the way down to the soil, sitting heavily on the ground
glow_concepts: small iron lanterns set into clipped niches
luminous white briar roses threaded through
firefly colony blinking through the leaves
new-growth tips glowing soft green along the trim
a candle niche cut into the hedge face
glowing sap threads veining the twigs
groups.animation_idea: waves of leaf-shiver running along the trimmed surface in the wind
groups.lore_fit: Farmstead boundary hedges are each era's remembered property lines, still clipped because their gardeners still speak of clipping them.

groups.name: Briar Thicket
groups.description: a dense sprawling bramble thicket of dark green leaves and thick arcing thorny stems, a low lush leafy mass hugging the ground with wild roses scattered through it
glow_concepts: rose blossoms glowing like paper lanterns
rose hips burning like strung embers
thorn tips sparking with points of light
a warm heart of light buried deep inside
glowworms strung along the arching canes
petals shedding slow drifting motes of light
moon-white roses casting a pale halo
groups.animation_idea: a loose petal breaking free and drifting to the ground
groups.lore_fit: Briar roses bloomed over Cherry Valley in every story the dead tell of it, so here they bloom in stubborn thorny plenty, keeping the Quiet out at the meadow edges.

groups.name: Bell Post
groups.description: a stout heavy timber post with a thick crossarm and a large bronze bell hanging from it, solid wide base
variety: weathered oak post, green patina bell
post with a small lantern hook beside the bell
glow_concepts: the bronze bell glowing furnace-warm
faint concentric light rings rippling from the bell
glowing pull-rope with luminous tassel
rune-carved crossbeam shining amber
small oil lamp hung beside the bell
soulstone clapper glinting inside the bell mouth
light-moths circling the bell
groups.animation_idea: bell swaying gently with faint light rings rippling outward
groups.lore_fit: A rung bell says a name out loud across the whole valley at once, firming the world like talk around a tended fire.

groups.name: Streetlight

glow_concepts: warm gas mantle flame behind glass panes
pale blue soul-light orb hovering inside

cluster of dripping candles behind the panes
cold gas-blue ring flame at the mantle
groups.animation_idea: flame guttering inside the head, halo slowly breathing
groups.lore_fit: Every era's dead remember their own street lighting, so gas lamps and iron lampposts stand along the same remembered lanes, each one lit only while somebody still keeps its street in mind.

groups.name: Flame Niche
groups.description: a small freestanding stone niche with an arched opening sheltering a little flame burning on a dish
glow_concepts: small orange flame on a stone dish
cold blue flame burning without fuel
bed of ember coals glowing deep red
white soul-flame hovering above a bare soulstone
gilded niche interior reflecting warm candlelight
row of tealights along the sill
sparks drifting up from the flame
groups.animation_idea: flame flickering with tiny sparks drifting upward
groups.lore_fit: A sheltered ever-burning flame is sacred infrastructure — a tended fire small enough to keep one memory warm.

groups.name: Haystack
groups.description: a big rounded stack of loose golden straw piled high on the ground, shaggy uneven surface with wisps sticking out, no pole through it

pale foxfire crust on the rotting side

groups.lore_fit: A haystack is a whole summer's work remembered at once — the proof a homestead would live through winter, and proof keeps its shape.

groups.name: Orchard Tree

amber light from a hive hollow

groups.animation_idea: a fruit-heavy bough dipping and bobbing lightly in the breeze
groups.lore_fit: The cherry and apple orchards are Nangijala's heart-image, rows of remembered harvests whose keeping firms up whole valleys at once.

groups.name: Wayside Shrine

painted door symbols traced in light
wisps sheltering under the roof

groups.lore_fit: Roadside shrines let every passing walker spend a moment of remembering, keeping the road itself firm.

groups.name: Fallen Log

glow_concepts: blue foxfire glowing in the bark cracks

a lit traveler's lantern resting on top
row of small glowing caps along the log's spine

groups.lore_fit: Even a tree's death is remembered here; a fallen trunk is the storm somebody still tells the story of.

groups.name: Story Post

glow_concepts: carved story scenes glowing panel by panel

glowing symbol hovering above the finial
groups.animation_idea: ribbons fluttering in the wind
groups.lore_fit: These are the told-aloud stations where stories must be retold, because what is spoken of holds its shape.

groups.name: Offering Table

groups.lore_fit: Setting out the food the dead loved re-tells who they were, feeding the memory rather than the body.

groups.name: Soulstone Outcrop

groups.lore_fit: Soulstones are what remains when a thing thins far enough — one fact pressed to mineral — and here they surface right out of the ground.

groups.name: Stump

ring of glowing mushrooms around the base

groups.lore_fit: A stump is a tree half-forgotten — felled in someone's memory yet too well-known to go soft — its rings a readable record of kept years.

groups.name: Bush
groups.description: a rounded dense shrub of layered foliage with a few thin woody stems showing at the base

phosphorescent rime edging every leaf
groups.animation_idea: the whole clump of foliage rustling in a light breeze
groups.lore_fit: Berry bushes are remembered hands-first — every picker who filled a pail keeps their bush standing at the field edge.

groups.name: Scarecrow

twin ember-orange eyes in the sack face
lantern hung from an outstretched arm
soul-light heart glowing through the coat
straw cuffs shedding drifting sparks of light
glowing stitched runes across the patches
groups.animation_idea: coat hem and straw fingers fluttering in the wind
groups.lore_fit: A scarecrow is an almost-person somebody made from remembered clothes, watched closely here in case it starts keeping a memory of its own.

groups.name: Cart

glow_concepts: candle lantern swinging from the cart shaft
cargo of softly glowing lantern-fruit
wheel hubs ringed with glowing painted charms

glowing chalk waymarks scrawled on the sideboards
groups.animation_idea: the hanging lantern swaying from the cart shaft
groups.lore_fit: Every homestead's goods rode a cart at least once, so the half-remembered roads keep their carts even where the horses that pulled them are gone.

groups.name: Barrel

glowing rune brand scorched into the staves

foxfire fungus fringing the damp base
groups.animation_idea: a slow drip from the tap with a rippling puddle
groups.lore_fit: Winter stores were counted and re-counted aloud until spring, and anything counted that often holds its shape for centuries.

groups.name: Hanging Lantern Stand

wickless ghost-flame hovering inside the cage

stained-glass panes throwing colored light

groups.lore_fit: Hanging a lantern out for travelers is a small act of keeping, and its swinging light marks the doorsteps of people the Quiet has not touched.

groups.name: Beehive

moon-pale gleaming wax drippings

groups.lore_fit: The living told their bees of every death in the family, so the hives of Nangijala already know everyone's name and never go quiet.

groups.name: Mushroom

groups.name: Reed Bed

groups.name: Cattail Clump

a foxfire ring around the wet base
a soulstone pebble shining among the roots

groups.lore_fit: Cattails are the torches of half-remembered childhood games, so they keep sprouting wherever the dead recall playing by the water.

groups.name: Flower Stand

glow_concepts: foxglove bells glowing like hanging lamps
luminous golden pollen motes drifting upward
petals edged with soft white light

night-blooms open and shining moon-pale

groups.lore_fit: Wild Rose Valley is named for its briars, and every posy the living once picked still blooms here exactly where its picker remembers kneeling.

groups.name: Dock Piling

ghost-blue barnacle rings glowing at the waterline

groups.name: Grass Tuft

groups.lore_fit: Meadow grass is the ground note of every remembered summer, so tufts of it spring up wherever anyone's memory of hayfields touches the world.

groups.name: Crystal

groups.name: Telegraph Pole
groups.description: a tall weathered wooden telegraph pole with a crossarm, ceramic insulators, and a sagging cut wire
glow_concepts: ceramic insulators glowing like small lanterns
pulses of light traveling along the sagging wire
pale ghost-fire crackling on the crossarm tips
carved initials in the wood glowing ember-orange
a lit storm lantern hung from a climbing peg
swarm of glowing moths circling the pole top
groups.animation_idea: the cut wire swinging gently in the wind
groups.lore_fit: Somebody's century still remembers sending word down the wire, so its poles march across meadows where no line was ever strung.

groups.name: Fish Drying Rack
groups.description: a wooden A-frame drying rack strung with rows of split fish hanging from cord lines, standing on trampled shore grass
glow_concepts: a low bed of smoking embers glowing beneath
fish scales shimmering with pale soul-light
a tallow lamp hanging from the crossbar
glowing smoke curling through the hanging fish
tiny votive candles strung along the frame
fireflies gathered on the top pole
groups.animation_idea: the hanging fish swaying slightly in the wind
groups.lore_fit: Whole coastal generations remember winters survived on racks like these, and remembered providence keeps the fish from ever spoiling.

groups.name: Moss Clump
groups.description: a flat spreading patch of thick velvety moss hugging the ground, creeping low across soil and over small stones, completely flat, not a dome and not a shrub
glow_concepts: constellation of glowing pinprick spore capsules
moss veined with glowing soulstone seams
gently pulsing green glow deep inside the clump
dew beads on the moss lit like glass lanterns
glowing footprint pressed into the moss top
rune-shaped bare patch glowing on the mound
groups.animation_idea: dew beads glinting as the cushion slowly swells and settles
groups.lore_fit: Moss creeps over whatever goes unspoken, padding the world's softening edges so the Quiet arrives gently.

groups.name: Beacon
groups.description: a tall tarred timber mast with climbing rungs and an iron fire cage mounted at its top
glow_concepts: great orange signal blaze in the cage
pillar of pale soul-light rising skyward
slow red ember eye pulsing in the cage
burning soulstone shining like a fixed star
cold green marsh-fire flame
spark column streaming off downwind
groups.animation_idea: blaze raging with sparks streaming off the cage
groups.lore_fit: A beacon is a whole village's agreement to remember the way home, raised high so its light can hold the valley's edges against the Quiet.

groups.name: Windmill
groups.description: a small stout field windmill with a solid timber tower and four broad heavy sails on thick wooden frames, shingled cap
glow_concepts: sail edges rimmed with pale spirit-light
glowing grain dust drifting from the loading door
ember-red glow at the hub of the sails
a lantern hung beside the boarded hatch
faint light leaking between the cap shingles
groups.animation_idea: the sails turning slowly in the wind
groups.lore_fit: A miller's whole certainty pressed into one small mill, grinding away in a field for bread nobody needs to eat.

groups.name: Maypole
groups.description: a tall midsummer maypole wrapped in birch leaves and flowers, a crossarm near the top with two flower wreaths hanging from its ends and long ribbons trailing
glow_concepts: the twin wreaths glowing like hung lanterns
ribbons streaming with woven light
spiral of fireflies climbing the pole
blossom wrappings shining soft pink-white
crown of warm light at the pole top
ghost-pale ring of dancers' light in the grass below
groups.animation_idea: ribbons and wreaths swaying gently in the breeze
groups.lore_fit: Midsummer is the one memory every generation of the dead shares, so a maypole still dressed keeps a whole village green firm against the Quiet.

groups.name: Market Stall
groups.description: a wooden market stall with a cloth canopy on poles and a plank counter stacked with goods
glow_concepts: paper lanterns strung along the canopy edge
counter of glowing honey jars and lit candles
canopy cloth lit from within like a tent
soulstone merchant scales shining on the counter
glowing chalked price-runes on the signboard
small coal brazier beside the counter
groups.animation_idea: the canopy edge fluttering and hanging goods swinging
groups.lore_fit: Market day is remembering out loud — prices, names and gossip repeated weekly for lifetimes — so stalls stand firm even in villages gone half-Quiet.

groups.name: Chimney Stack
groups.description: a lone stone chimney standing on open grass, with a soot-blackened hearth opening at its base and a crumbling brick crown
glow_concepts: hearthfire still burning in the soot-black hearth
warm light spilling from the flue top
embers breathing deep red in the firebox
ghost outline of the vanished house glowing faintly
soot marks above the mantel glowing like runes
smoke of soft light curling from the crown
groups.animation_idea: hearth flames flickering while thin smoke curls from the crown
groups.lore_fit: When a house goes unspoken of, the hearth is the last part to soften — the fire everyone gathered at stands long after the walls are gone.

groups.name: Ruined Arch
groups.description: a freestanding ruined stone archway with crumbling voussoirs, a worn threshold, and rubble at its feet
glow_concepts: a faint curtain of light filling the opening
glowing keystone at the crown
rune-carved voussoirs glowing one by one
luminous briar roses climbing one side
pinpoints of light in the crumbled mortar joints
cold aurora shimmer hanging under the arch
groups.animation_idea: briar rose vines swaying against the stonework
groups.lore_fit: Every era built doorways, and in Nangijala the doorway outlives its wall — an opening still held open by the habit of walking through.

groups.name: Hanging Willow
groups.description: a weeping willow tree with long curtain-like branches trailing all the way to the ground
glow_concepts: every strand tipped with a droplet of light
a lantern glowing behind the branch curtain
fireflies drifting slowly between the hanging strands
catkins burning like rows of candle flames
soul-light pooled in the hollow of the trunk
leaves that hold moonlight long after dark
bright sap beads glowing along the bark
groups.animation_idea: the branch curtains rippling gently in the wind
groups.lore_fit: Willows lean over every riverbank the dead remember, curtained trees a child could hide inside, and grief keeps them greener than anything else in the valley.

groups.name: Puffball
groups.description: a plump round puffball mushroom sitting directly on bare earth
glow_concepts: whole ball glowing like a round paper lamp
crack pattern glowing across the leathery skin
top vent breathing out glowing spore dust
ring of glowing freckles around the middle
slow heartbeat pulse of light under the skin
burst husk spilling a pile of glowing spores
groups.animation_idea: puffball venting a little spore cloud in a slow rhythm
groups.lore_fit: Each puff scatters spores like retold stories, seeding firm ground downwind of wherever people still talk.

groups.name: Soulstone Plinth
groups.description: a faceted mineral soulstone resting on a carved stone plinth, ringed by small offerings at its base
glow_concepts: the soulstone's core pulsing with inner light
bright veins branching through the stone
thin column of light rising from the stone
motes orbiting the stone in slow rings
carved word on the plinth glowing
glass dome scattering the stone's glow
luminous crystal frost spreading down the pedestal
groups.animation_idea: core light pulsing like a slow heartbeat with orbiting motes
groups.lore_fit: When a memory has thinned to one mineral fact, displaying its soulstone keeps that last fact spoken for.

groups.name: Gravel Pile
groups.description: a loose heaped mound of small stones and gravel with scattered pebbles spilling around its base
glow_concepts: scattered pebbles glowing like banked coals
faint ember light rising between the stones
one bright glowing shard atop the pile
phosphorescent dust film over the surface
trickle of glowing pebbles down one side
groups.animation_idea: a loose pebble occasionally trickling down the slope
groups.lore_fit: The crumb left behind when a quarry or roadwork goes half-forgotten — memory ground down but not yet gone to the Quiet.

groups.name: Aqueduct Fragment
groups.description: a freestanding fragment of a stone aqueduct, one arch on weathered piers with a broken water channel on top
glow_concepts: ghostly luminous water still flowing along the top channel
glowing drips falling from the underside of the arch
soulstone veins glowing through cracked masonry
bioluminescent moss lining the mortar joints
keystone carved with a softly glowing sigil
votive candles flickering in a pier niche
groups.animation_idea: remembered water trickling and dripping from the broken channel
groups.lore_fit: The oldest dead still trust their empire's stonework, so its arches stand beside cherry orchards, carrying water only they remember.

groups.name: Driftwood Log
groups.description: a weathered silver-grey driftwood log with twisted broken branch stubs, half sunk in sand and pebbles at the shore
glow_concepts: shipworm bore holes leaking pale light
glowing salt crystals crusted along the grain
foxfire fungus shelves on the damp side
a soulstone vein running through the split wood
mourners' carved initials glowing faintly
ghost-blue barnacle colonies at the sand line
groups.animation_idea: a caught gull feather fluttering on a branch stub
groups.lore_fit: Every drowned sailor and river child remembers wood the water gave back, so the shores of Nangijala are strewn with it.

groups.name: Cup Fungus
groups.description: a cluster of small goblet-shaped cup fungi growing from mossy ground
glow_concepts: each cup brimming with glowing liquid light
cup rims glowing ember orange like wicks
thin steam of light rising from the cups
single glowing raindrop pooled in every cup
inner cup walls glowing like lantern glass
glowing haze puffing from the cups
groups.animation_idea: faint luminous steam curling up out of the cups
groups.lore_fit: Little cups that hold light the way the valley holds its tended fires, keeping a sip of memory lit through the night.

groups.name: Waterwheel
groups.description: an old abandoned wooden waterwheel detached from any mill, leaning half-fallen against a mossy stone stub, its planks weathered and gaps in its paddles, overgrown with ivy and moss, long out of use
variety: wheel sunk to its axle in grass
glow_concepts: glow-moss padding the old spokes
fireflies drifting through the broken paddles
soul-light seeping from the axle hollow
groups.animation_idea: the wheel creaking a few degrees and settling back
groups.lore_fit: Somebody remembers the mill fondly but not exactly, so only its wheel endures, leaning wherever the meadow will hold it.

groups.name: Ancient Tree
groups.description: an enormous ancient tree with a gnarled hollow trunk, sprawling surface roots, and a vast twisted crown
glow_concepts: strings of paper lanterns wound through the branches
glowing runes spiraling up the trunk
soulstone veins shining through split bark
hollow heart glowing like embers inside
crown wreathed in drifting golden memory-motes
candlelit shrines tucked between the roots
stacked bracket fungi glowing phosphorescent green
groups.animation_idea: the massive crown breathing in a slow sway while motes drift down through it
groups.lore_fit: A tree spoken of for generations becomes a landmark certainty, older and firmer than the ground it stands on, and whole districts of the dead navigate by it.

groups.name: Broken Column
groups.description: the broken stump of an ancient fluted stone column standing on a square base, its top snapped at an angle
glow_concepts: a band of carved runes glowing around the shaft
soulstone veins shining in the fracture face
lines of light pooled in the fluting grooves
bioluminescent ivy spiraling up the stump
a votive candle burning on the broken top
ember-orange cracks like cooling magma
groups.animation_idea: ivy leaves fluttering against the shaft
groups.lore_fit: A temple nobody fully remembers has thinned to its last certain piece: one column somebody once leaned against and never forgot.

groups.name: Fading Relic
groups.description: the ghost of a piece of old furniture standing alone on grass, strongly translucent and spectral, its lower half dissolving into drifting mist and scattered motes of light, see-through pale blue glow
glow_concepts: the remembered half glowing while the rest fades
bright memory-outline tracing the missing parts
drifting motes of light unraveling from the edges
soulstone crystallizing at the dissolved corner
a lit candle left beside it in remembrance
ghost-white afterimage hovering slightly offset
soft aurora shimmer across the thinned surface
groups.animation_idea: the faded half slowly flickering between half-visible and almost gone
groups.lore_fit: These are the Quiet made visible — furniture nobody speaks of anymore, caught halfway between remembered and gone.

groups.name: Water Lily Clump
groups.description: a floating clump of overlapping round water lily pads with a few cupped blossoms and short trailing stems, drawn alone with no water beneath
glow_concepts: blossoms glowing from within like floating lanterns
pad rims traced in bioluminescent light
glowing pollen hearts at each bloom's center
soul-light shining up through gaps between pads
dew beads lit like tiny stars
a will-o-wisp resting on the largest pad
groups.animation_idea: pads drifting gently on a slow ripple
groups.lore_fit: Lilies bloom over the deepest remembered water, each flower marking a place where someone was last looked for; shipped as water-overlay scenery for maps2 to place only on water tiles.

groups.name: Flower Trellis
groups.description: a freestanding wooden lattice trellis on stout legs, covered in climbing flowering vines
glow_concepts: every blossom lit from within like lanterns
fireflies weaving through the lattice squares
sap glowing in bright lines along the stems
a candle lantern hung at the trellis peak
pollen sifting down as glowing dust
carved runes on the frame glowing softly
moonflowers open and shining white
groups.animation_idea: leaves fluttering while one heavy blossom nods on its stem
groups.lore_fit: Cottage gardeners keep their trellises exactly as they were proudest of them, and a well-spoken-of trellis stays sharp-edged while the beds around it soften.

groups.name: Petrified Stump
groups.description: a tree stump turned entirely to grey banded stone, cold mineral colors with agate rings on the cut top, clearly rock not wood, no brown bark
glow_concepts: growth rings glowing amber in the cut top
opalized bark shimmering with rainbow light
roots traced in glowing gold veins
small ghost-flames where branches once grew
glowing moss and fungus on stone bark
sap channels lit like slow embers
groups.animation_idea: amber ring-light breathing slowly while spore motes rise
groups.lore_fit: Orchards that thinned toward the Quiet but were remembered just enough to stay — trees pressed down into their own stone monuments.

groups.name: Hop Pole
groups.description: a tall slender wooden pole with hop bines spiraling to its top, heavy with pale green cones
glow_concepts: hop cones glowing like strings of paper lanterns
a glowworm spiral climbing the bine
foxfire light seeping from the pole's split core
the topmost cone shining like a beacon star
cones dusted with luminous golden pollen
a thin line of glowing sap spiraling upward
groups.animation_idea: the bine tip high above swaying in a slow circle
groups.lore_fit: Brewers from every century remember their hop gardens at harvest, and the beer poured around tended fires keeps the poles standing tall and certain.

groups.name: Beast Skull
groups.description: a large weathered animal skull resting on grassy ground, bleached bone with empty eye sockets, cracked surfaces and a heavy jaw
glow_concepts: ember soul-light glowing in the eye sockets
luminous green moss patched over the crown
carved memory-runes glowing along the brow
soulstone crystal budding from a cracked socket
candle stub burning between the antlers
faint ghost-flesh shimmer outlining the skull
foxfire fungus shelf glowing on the jaw
groups.animation_idea: a butterfly settling on the antler tip, slowly fanning its wings, then fluttering off
groups.lore_fit: Bones are the last firm fact of a beast, still held in shape by every hunter and child who told of it.

groups.name: Rusted Machine
groups.description: a rusted derelict machine of boiler, pipes, gears and a big flywheel mounted on an iron frame, streaked with corrosion
glow_concepts: one round gauge face still lit warm
ember glow through the furnace grate
blue sparks arcing between corroded terminals
a small pilot flame under the boiler
luminous oil seeping from a riveted seam
copper coils holding a faint galvanic glow
groups.animation_idea: a gauge needle twitching with an occasional puff of steam
groups.lore_fit: An engineer's pride outlasts its factory: the machine idles in a meadow, kept solid by everyone who ever bragged about it.

groups.name: Owl Snag
groups.description: a tall dead tree trunk with broken-off branch stubs and peeling bark, a dark round hollow opening in the trunk where an owl roosts
glow_concepts: owl eyes glowing from the dark hollow
hollow lit from within like a lantern window
foxfire brackets stepping up the trunk
luminous moss sleeving one side
carved name-runes glowing on the bark
soulstone knot where a branch broke off
small wisps circling the broken top
groups.animation_idea: the owl in the hollow blinking slowly and swiveling its head
groups.lore_fit: Dead trees stand long in Nangijala because owls are watched and spoken of, and speaking keeps the snag from thinning.

groups.name: Bone Pile
groups.description: sun-bleached animal bones heaped on the ground, a curved ribcage arc and scattered vertebrae with grass growing up between them
glow_concepts: warm marrow-light leaking through hairline cracks
will-o-wisp hovering inside the ribcage
phosphorescent lichen freckling the ribs
votive candles wedged among the bones
soulstone seam fusing two ribs together
spectral beast outline flickering over its bones
glowing knotted memory-cords wound around the ribs
groups.animation_idea: tall grass swaying around the bones while one loose rib rocks and settles
groups.lore_fit: Even beasts are remembered in Nangijala, and their bones lie where a story once put them, kept solid by retelling.

groups.name: Rail Cart
groups.description: a derelict abandoned wooden mine cart, weathered and rusted, tipped beside a short piece of broken track half-buried in grass and weeds, long out of use
variety: rusted cart sunk to its axles
cart with a broken wheel leaning beside it
glow_concepts: glowing ore chunks left in the bed
soul-light pooling under the cart
glow-moss lining the rotted planks
groups.animation_idea: the cart rocking slightly on its rails with a settling creak
groups.lore_fit: The mines are stories now, but a cart that once mattered to someone still sits where the story left it.

groups.name: Overgrown Archway
groups.description: a freestanding stone garden arch swallowed by climbing vines and hanging blossom
glow_concepts: keystone carved with a softly glowing name
blossoms strung along the curve like lanterns
pale memory-light filling the opening like a curtain
foxfire moss glowing in the stone seams
fireflies gathered thick under the arch
soulstone chips in the mortar, veined with light
hanging seed pods glowing like small lamps
groups.animation_idea: loose vine strands swinging slowly in the opening
groups.lore_fit: Every era's dead remember a gateway they were proud to walk through, so arches stand alone in the meadows long after the walls they belonged to were forgotten.

groups.name: Flower Garland
groups.description: a thick lush rope of flowers and greenery swagged between two stout timber posts set solidly in the ground, heavy with dense blooms
glow_concepts: tiny paper lanterns tied along the swag
blossoms lit like a string of fairy lights
glowing ribbon threads woven through the garland
candle stubs burning on each post top
dew beads shining lamp-bright along the swag
post tops carved with glowing painted names
groups.animation_idea: the garland swag bobbing gently between the posts
groups.lore_fit: Midsummer is remembered by every generation of the dead at once, so garlands stay strung year-round, marking ground made firm by festivals and talk.

groups.name: Hanging Basket
groups.description: a wide woven basket packed with flowers spilling thick trailing blooms over its sides, resting on a stout low wooden stand on the ground
glow_concepts: the basket glowing from within like a lantern
each flower lit like a small flame
a candle nested in among the blooms
the iron crook tip glowing lantern-warm
trailing vines dripping slow glowing droplets
moss lining glowing soft foxfire green
groups.animation_idea: the basket swinging slightly on its creaking hook
groups.lore_fit: Hanging a light and flowers out for travelers is old lantern courtesy, and the dead keep the habit even where the door it belonged to is gone.

groups.name: Stone Fountain
groups.description: a small round village fountain of fitted grey stone, a mossy basin with a carved central spout trickling water
glow_concepts: the basin water glowing pale gold
votive candles ringing the basin rim
carved memorial runes shining on the stone
offering coins gleaming with soul-light underwater
foxfire moss patching the wet stone
the spout stream falling as a ribbon of light
groups.animation_idea: water trickling and rippling in the basin
groups.lore_fit: Every village square in living memory had a fountain, and the sound of one still running keeps a whole square from going quiet.

groups.name: Rock Spire
groups.description: a tall narrow natural rock pinnacle rising from a broad stone base, eroded, layered and top-heavy
glow_concepts: summit glowing like a lighthouse lamp
banded strata glowing in warm layers
swarm of glowing motes spiraling upward
crystal seams flashing down its length
eroded hollows lit from inside
tip capped in cold starlight
groups.animation_idea: glowing motes spiraling slowly up around the spire
groups.lore_fit: A landmark pointed at from afar by so many of the dead that it keeps its exact silhouette across every era's world.

groups.name: Trailing Planter
groups.description: a heavy terracotta pot packed with flowers, thick vines cascading down over its sides, sitting solidly on the ground
glow_concepts: blossoms glowing like banked coals
light leaking through cracks between the staves
silvery glowing snail trails across the barrel
fireflies sheltering under the trailing leaves
vine tips glowing like tiny candle wicks
iron hoops etched with faintly glowing runes
groups.animation_idea: the trailing vine tips stirring softly against the barrel
groups.lore_fit: A barrel of flowers by the door is the plainest certainty of home the dead carry, so planters bloom on doorsteps whose houses have long since gone soft.

groups.name: Wisteria Snag
groups.description: a dead leafless tree draped in woody wisteria vines with long hanging clusters of flowers
glow_concepts: flower clusters glowing like hanging lamps
vine coils traced in thin violet light
seed pods cracked open and leaking light
growth rings glowing at the snapped limbs
luminous moths at rest among the blooms
fallen petals glowing in a ring below
a soulstone in the trunk hollow, veins alight
groups.animation_idea: the long flower clusters swinging like slow pendulums
groups.lore_fit: The tree itself died long ago, but its flowering is still spoken of every spring, so the wisteria returns to dress the dead wood in what it is remembered for.

groups.name: Giant Mushroom
groups.description: a huge tree-sized mushroom with a thick fibrous stalk and a broad domed cap
glow_concepts: underside of the huge cap glowing like a lamp ceiling
bright gill slats radiating light beneath the cap
glowing sap veins climbing the thick stalk
cap spots lit like little cottage windows
halo of drifting luminous spores around the cap rim
band of foxfire ringing the stalk base
groups.animation_idea: cap swaying gently while spore motes fall like slow snow
groups.lore_fit: In woods drifting toward the Quiet, growth stops obeying anyone's certainty, and mushrooms nobody contradicts swell to the size of trees.

groups.name: Nest Post
groups.description: a weathered wooden post with a woven twig bird nest built on top, straw and moss sticking out of the rounded nest cup
glow_concepts: eggs glowing warm through the woven twigs
fireflies nesting among the sticks
hoarded glass beads shining in the nest cup
small tin lantern hung from the post
phantom bird of light brooding on the nest
glowworm strands dangling from the nest rim
waymark rune on the post glowing softly
groups.animation_idea: nestling heads popping up with open beaks, then ducking back down into the cup
groups.lore_fit: Every fence post is somebody's certainty, and the birds of the dead still build on what the living remember standing upright.

groups.name: Web Frame
groups.description: a dense heavy spiderweb spun across the gap between two thick weathered leaning posts, sagging with dew
glow_concepts: dewdrops on the web lit like strung lanterns
the silk spiral itself glowing moon-white
wrapped prey bundles glowing like paper lanterns
tiny glowing spider sitting at the hub
web spun into a glowing rune pattern
frame wood veined with glinting soulstone
ghost-light halo where threads have thinned away
groups.animation_idea: the web rippling gently in the breeze while the spider bobs at the hub
groups.lore_fit: Frames whose houses have gone quiet stand alone in the meadows, and spiders web over the gaps the Quiet left.

groups.name: Cliff Fragment
groups.description: a massive sharp-edged chunk of broken cliff rock lying where it fell, one face freshly fractured and pale
glow_concepts: exposed crystal pocket blazing on the fracture face
glowing fossil spiral embedded in the surface
glowing ore veins branching like lightning
curtain of glowing green moss down one side
raw break faces shining pale white
warm light from a sheltered hollow beneath
groups.animation_idea: dust sifting from the cracks while moss sways gently
groups.lore_fit: A piece of a remembered mountain that outlived the mountain itself when the Quiet took the rest of the range.

groups.name: Ant Hill
groups.description: a mounded anthill of soil and pine needles rising from the grass, dotted with small dark entrance holes and tiny crawling ants
glow_concepts: entrance holes glowing like tiny furnace vents
glowing ant trail spiraling up the mound
lit inner tunnels showing through thin soil
phosphorescent fungus ring around the base
soulstone grains sparkling through the dirt
ants carrying glowing ember crumbs
thin wisps of light rising from the crown
groups.animation_idea: lines of ants trickling in and out of the entrance holes
groups.lore_fit: The small diligent lives of the meadow are remembered too, and their mounds firm up wherever people once watched ants work.

groups.name: Beached Rowboat
groups.description: a small clinker-built wooden rowboat pulled up onto the shore, resting tilted on the sand with oars shipped inside
glow_concepts: a storm lantern glowing at the prow
the painted name on the hull glowing softly
bioluminescent algae ring along the waterline stain
warm soul-light seeping between the planks
a candle stub burning on the rowing thwart
glowing net floats heaped in the stern
groups.animation_idea: a loose mooring rope swaying against the hull
groups.lore_fit: For many the crossing into Nangijala was a last ferry over dark water, and each beached hull is somebody's arrival still held ashore.

groups.name: Geode
groups.description: a round rough stone cracked open to reveal a hollow interior lined with pointed crystals
glow_concepts: crystal-lined mouth glowing violet from within
thin beam of light escaping the crack
interior glow pulsing like a slow heartbeat
sugar-crystal lining glittering with tiny sparks
opening rimmed in soft ember light
groups.animation_idea: crystal lining glinting as the interior glow flickers
groups.lore_fit: Memory keeps its brightest part hidden — a plain stone that cracks open to show the light it has been holding all along.

groups.name: Wasp Nest Tree
groups.description: a small gnarled tree with a large gray paper wasp nest hanging from a branch, layered papery swirls around a round entrance hole
glow_concepts: paper nest lit from inside like a lantern
glowing wasps drifting like slow sparks
amber honey seep glowing down the bark
nest entrance glowing like a blown ember
faint light bands between the papery layers
foxfire brackets climbing the trunk
ghost-pale nest turned translucent and shining
groups.animation_idea: wasps drifting lazily in and out of the nest entrance while the nest sways slightly
groups.lore_fit: Everyone remembers the tree they were told never to poke, so the gray paper nests hang unusually firm.

groups.name: Woodpile
groups.description: a neatly stacked pile of split firewood logs with a chopping block and an axe standing beside it
glow_concepts: log ends glowing like a wall of embers
axe blade shining with cold soul-light
warm hearthlight leaking between the split logs
foxfire fungus on the bottom mossy row
one glowing log deep in the dark stack
sparks of light drifting off fresh-split wood
groups.animation_idea: a loose log settling as fine wood dust drifts
groups.lore_fit: Firewood laid up for winter feeds the tended fires, and a full woodpile is the standing promise that a fire will not be allowed to go out.

groups.name: Letter Box
groups.description: a chunky wooden mailbox with a heavy rounded body on a thick square post with a wide solid base
glow_concepts: letters glowing warm gold through the slot
painted name on the box shining softly
wax seals glowing like small embers
one bright letter lit among dark ones
small lantern hooked beneath the box
address runes glowing down the post
groups.animation_idea: the hinged lid lifting slightly and settling as if breathing
groups.lore_fit: The dead write letters to the still-living and to each other, and every letter waiting in a box is a name being spoken in ink.

groups.name: Statue
groups.description: a weathered stone statue of a standing figure on a low square pedestal, features softened by age
glow_concepts: eyes glowing with soft white light
golden light filling the cracks like kintsugi
glowing tear tracks running down the face
a halo of pale light above the head
the held lantern or sword faintly alight
constellation of glowing lichen spots on the stone
ring of votive candles around the pedestal
whole figure translucent, lit from within
groups.animation_idea: moths slowly circling the statue's head
groups.lore_fit: A statue is a memory somebody already pressed into stone while alive, so here it stands twice-remembered — hardest of all for the Quiet to take.

groups.name: Rope Swing
groups.description: a wooden swing hanging by two ropes from a stout timber frame, its plank seat swaying above a patch of worn bare ground
glow_concepts: the empty seat glowing softly as if just left
ropes glowing like two threads of light
ghost-light of a small sitter flickering on the seat
fireflies ringing the frame top
carved initials on the crossbeam glowing warm
worn ground beneath shining in a faint ring
groups.animation_idea: the empty seat swinging gently as if someone just jumped off
groups.lore_fit: Children remember swings with their whole bodies, so the swings of Nangijala keep swinging over ground worn bare by feet that still return.

groups.name: Water Pump
groups.description: a cast-iron village hand pump with a long curved handle and a spout hanging over a small stone splash slab
glow_concepts: spout trickling a thread of glowing water
handle worn to a warm hand-shaped glow
glowing droplets beading the spout mouth
maker's name on the casting shining softly
pale light welling up from the splash slab
tin cup brimming with luminous water
groups.animation_idea: the handle dipping slowly as a trickle falls from the spout
groups.lore_fit: Every era pumped its own water, and a pump that still primes means the dooryard it served is still spoken of.

groups.name: Anchor
groups.description: a large rusted ship anchor standing propped ashore, one fluke sunk into the ground and a length of heavy chain pooled at its base
glow_concepts: chain links glowing like strung embers
ghost-blue barnacle colonies freckling the iron
ship's name on the stock shining softly
soul-light pooling where the fluke bites the ground
rust cracks glowing furnace-orange
a lantern hung from the anchor ring
groups.animation_idea: the loose chain end swaying and clinking softly
groups.lore_fit: An anchor set ashore is a sailor's promise that the voyage is over, holding whole harbors of memory fast against the Quiet.

groups.name: Sundial
groups.description: a stone pedestal sundial standing on grass, with a round engraved dial plate and a triangular gnomon
glow_concepts: hour lines glowing in sequence around the dial
the gnomon's shadow burning as a line of light
engraved motto glowing around the rim
brass plate shining moon-pale
a wrong-time shadow glowing where no sun stands
dial numerals lit like small windows
groups.animation_idea: the glowing shadow line creeping slowly around the dial
groups.lore_fit: Time runs strangely where every era stands at once, and each sundial in Nangijala keeps the hour its keeper remembers best.

groups.name: Spring Basin
groups.description: a natural spring welling up in a shallow rocky hollow, wet mossy boulders ringing a pool of clear water, no built stonework
glow_concepts: soul-light welling up from the basin's throat
glowing bubbles rising and bursting
rune-carved rim stones shining faintly
lit mist curling off the warm water
moonmilk mineral crust glowing on the rim stones
groups.animation_idea: bubbles rising as rings spread across the water surface
groups.lore_fit: Springs are where the land remembers water beginning, and drinking from a kept basin is said to steady whatever in you has gone thin.

groups.name: Sheaf Pole
groups.description: a wooden pole with a fat sheaf of oats bound at its top, grain heads nodding over a tied straw cord
glow_concepts: grain heads glowing like strings of tiny lamps
golden chaff motes drifting off the sheaf
glowing birds of light perched among the grain
straw binding shining like a hot band
the whole sheaf haloed warm against dusk
seed heads sparking softly as they nod
groups.animation_idea: grain heads nodding while sparrows flutter in and out
groups.lore_fit: Setting out the midwinter sheaf for the birds is remembered kindness, and kindness repeated every year holds its pole upright for centuries.

groups.name: Dovecote
groups.description: a stout free-standing dovecote tower of stone and timber standing directly on the ground on a wide base, rows of arched pigeon holes up its sides, landing ledges, and a shingled roof
glow_concepts: pigeon holes lit from within like little windows
white doves glowing faintly as they roost
warm straw light spilling from the arched openings
ring of pale glowing feathers on the ground
roof finial shining like a small star
ghost-doves of light circling the roof
groups.animation_idea: doves shuffling on the ledges, one fluttering off and returning
groups.lore_fit: Doves carried messages and meant home, so the dead keep their cotes stocked and something white still flies between the remembered farms.

groups.name: Rocking Horse
groups.description: a wooden rocking horse seen from the side, a chunky carved horse body standing on thick curved rockers
glow_concepts: glass eyes glowing softly amber
saddle shining where small hands held on
rockers leaving glowing curved tracks in the grass
mane streaming with faint light
candle stub burning between the rockers
painted dapples lit like tiny lanterns
groups.animation_idea: rocking gently on its own with a slow creak
groups.lore_fit: The toys of remembered nurseries wander out into the meadows, still rocking because somewhere a grown soul still speaks of being small.

groups.name: Anvil
groups.description: a heavy black iron blacksmith's anvil mounted on a broad oak stump, its top face bare and empty
glow_concepts: the face glowing forge-yellow as if just struck
a cooling horseshoe shining ember-red on top
hammer sparks of light frozen mid-scatter above
smith's touchmark glowing on the flank
the horn tip shining white-hot
warm forge-light pooling in the stump's cracks
groups.animation_idea: a faint ring of sparks scattering as if from an unseen hammer blow
groups.lore_fit: The smith's trade is remembered in every era at once, and an anvil rings on in the meadow long after its forge went soft.

groups.name: Charcoal Kiln
groups.description: a tall clay-domed charcoal kiln mound with ridged earthen sides, pocked with small vent holes seeping thin smoke
glow_concepts: vent holes glowing like furnace mouths
molten light seams cracking up the flanks
banded rings of ember glow around the dome
soulstone core shining through a broken flank
sparks drifting from the crown vent
inner charcoal bed glowing through deep cracks
groups.animation_idea: heat shimmer and thin smoke rising from the vent holes
groups.lore_fit: Charcoal burners watched their smoking mounds night and day for weeks, and a thing watched that hard keeps burning here, feeding the valley's tended fires.

groups.name: Beaver Lodge
groups.description: a rounded dome lodge of gnawed sticks and packed mud built up at the shore, pale chewed log ends bristling from the weave
glow_concepts: lodge-light glowing through gaps between the sticks
ghostly beaver light glimpsed inside the lattice
gnawed branch tips glowing like ember pokers
soulstone pebbles packed into the mud
fireflies hovering low over the dome
groups.animation_idea: one loose twig quivering while warm light flickers inside the dome
groups.lore_fit: Streams remember being worked, and the lodges of long-dead beavers stand at the shore because valley folk still tell where the water pooled.

groups.name: Cliff Vine
groups.description: a long thick curtain of climbing vine cascading straight down a rock face, dense overlapping leaves forming a heavy vertical mass, made to hang over a cliff wall
glow_concepts: luminous sap veins glowing through the leaves
pale blue soul-flowers dotted down the fall
glowworm colonies strung in the foliage
amber memory-light dripping from the tips
moonlit silver shimmer across the leaves
groups.animation_idea: leaves rippling in a draft down the rock face
groups.lore_fit: The mountains are the oldest memories in Nangijala, and green still climbs them wherever names are spoken often.

groups.name: Cliff Feature
groups.description: a chunky rock-face feature made to sit over a cliff wall: a jutting mossy ledge, a thick protruding root knot, or a deep cracked seam in the stone, heavy and solid
variety: thick gnarled root bursting from the rock
deep cracked seam with ferns growing out
dark water seep staining the stone
small ledge shrub on an outcrop
clay swallow nests under an overhang
spiral fossil embedded in the stone face
glow_concepts: soulstone seam glowing inside the crack
warm light spilling from a deep crevice
glow-lichen shelf shining pale green
fireflies drifting around the ledge
groups.animation_idea: a thin trickle of dust falling from the ledge
groups.lore_fit: Even a wall of old stone keeps small lives and small lights in its cracks.

groups.name: Table
groups.description: a stout wooden household table with thick legs and a heavy top, set for daily life, standing solidly on the floor
variety: table set with bowls and bread
table with a jug of wildflowers
heavy oak table with carved legs
kitchen work table with chopping block
table draped with a woven cloth
table with sewing basket and folded cloth
table with clay cups and a pitcher
table with a steaming soup pot
glow_concepts: a lit candle stub in a brass holder on the tabletop
a small glass-hooded oil lamp glowing at its center
memory-light pooling in the wood grain
groups.animation_idea: the candleflame swaying gently
groups.lore_fit: A laid table says someone is expected home, and in Nangijala someone always is.

groups.name: Chair
groups.description: a sturdy wooden seat for a house: a chunky chair, stool or short bench with thick legs, standing solidly on the floor
glow_concepts: a knitted blanket glowing faintly with kept warmth
a small candle lantern hung on the chair back
groups.animation_idea: the rocking chair rocking slowly on its own
groups.lore_fit: Every remembered kitchen keeps its chairs pulled out a little, ready.

groups.name: Bed
groups.description: a solid wooden box bed with a thick quilted cover and a plump pillow, heavy frame standing on the floor
variety: small child's bed with a rag doll
sturdy iron-frame bed with brass knobs
glow_concepts: a warming pan glowing at the foot of the bed
a candle on the headboard shelf
moonglow pooling on the quilt
a little nightlight lantern beside the pillow
groups.animation_idea: the quilt rising and falling as if someone breathes beneath it
groups.lore_fit: The dead still sleep — not because they must, but because dreams are where the living visit.

groups.name: Cupboard
groups.description: a heavy floor-standing piece of wooden storage furniture: a cupboard, dresser or laden shelf unit with thick boards, made to stand against a wall
variety: open shelf unit of jars and crocks
bookshelf of worn plain cloth-bound books with blank spines
apothecary chest of many small drawers
glow_concepts: jars of glowing preserves on the shelves
lamplight seeping from behind the cupboard doors
a glowing kettle resting on the sideboard
groups.animation_idea: a cupboard door drifting open a crack and closing again
groups.lore_fit: Shelves are how a house remembers out loud: everything kept where it was always kept.

groups.name: Hearth
groups.description: a heavy stone fireplace hearth with a thick mantel and a fire space, solid masonry built to stand against a house wall
variety: fieldstone hearth with an iron cook pot
brick hearth with a baking oven
hearth with drying herbs on the mantel
small cottage hearth with a kettle
hearth with copper pans hung beside it
hearth with a cat asleep on the warm stone
cold swept hearth with stacked logs
glow_concepts: fire burning warm in the hearth mouth
embers breathing orange under the cook pot
coals banked for the night glowing low
groups.animation_idea: the fire flickering and a curl of smoke rising
groups.lore_fit: The hearth is the first thing a remembered house gets right; the fire has burned since someone first told the story.

groups.name: Rug
groups.description: a flat woven floor rug lying on the ground seen from above, thick fabric with a bold folk pattern, completely flat underfoot
glow_concepts: pattern threads shimmering with woven memory-light
warm hearthlight reflected across the pile
groups.animation_idea: a corner of the rug lifting in a draft and settling
groups.lore_fit: A rug marks the warm middle of a room the way a fire marks a camp.

groups.name: House Clutter
groups.description: a small chunky cluster of household things arranged together on the floor, solid everyday objects with visible weight
variety: flour sack leaning on a crock
basket of wool with knitting needles
string of onions coiled in a bowl
toy blocks and a rag doll
glow_concepts: a covered lantern set among the things
a little oil lamp burning beside the basket
embers glowing in a small warming pot
groups.animation_idea: a mouse darting between the jugs and vanishing
groups.lore_fit: Clutter is proof of living; empty rooms are how the Quiet gets in.

groups.name: Wall Hanging
groups.description: a solid decorative piece made to hang flat on an interior wall, seen straight on, chunky and clearly readable at a glance
variety: mounted deer antlers on a wooden plaque
herb bundles drying on a rail
framed folk embroidery with pattern only
small mounted shelf of jars on brackets
hunting horn hanging on a strap
glow_concepts: the candle sconce lit warm
jars glowing on the mounted shelf
embroidery threads shimmering with memory-light
groups.animation_idea: the hanging pans swaying and knocking softly once
groups.lore_fit: Walls with things on them are walls someone chose; bare walls are just weather kept out.
